records.claim: The Skilled Work Experience pathway excludes Red List occupations and ANZSCO skill levels 4 or 5. Amber List occupations require at least 1.2 times the SMC wage threshold, at least 3 years of relevant work experience in New Zealand in an ANZSCO skill level 1 to 3 occupation, and an additional 2 years of qualifying skilled work experience in New Zealand at the 1.2-times threshold. Standard eligible roles require at least 5 years of directly relevant work experience including 2 years of skilled work experience in New Zealand at 1.1 times the applicable threshold.
records.methodology: Direct review of current official Red and Amber List and SMC pathway guidance; matrix is route-scoped and does not infer eligibility for other residence pathways.

records.claim: For Skilled Work Experience, the applicable wage threshold is determined by when qualifying New Zealand skilled work starts. From 9 March 2026 the SMC threshold is NZD 35.00/hour, with 1.1 times = NZD 38.50/hour for standard roles and 1.2 times = NZD 42.00/hour for Amber List roles. Earlier effective periods must use their corresponding historical threshold. A qualifying grace period may apply when work begins within 5 months of visa grant under the official conditions.
records.methodology: Direct review of the current official SMC wage-rate tables and effective-date rules; values are retained as regression fixtures and must not be generalized beyond the published periods.

records.claim: The Trades and Technician pathway is restricted to occupations on the official eligible occupation list and requires a relevant qualification at Level 4, comparable to Level 4, or higher, plus the prescribed post-qualification work experience. The current rule requires at least 2.5 years of relevant post-qualification experience in an ANZSCO skill level 1 to 3 occupation and an additional 1.5 years of post-qualification skilled work experience in New Zealand. Overseas Trade and Technician qualifications no longer need the former 120-credit requirement; New Zealand qualifications retain a 120-credit requirement, which may be met through more than one prerequisite-linked qualification.
records.methodology: Direct review of the current official eligible-occupation list and final 2026 SMC qualification changes; overseas and New Zealand qualification rules are kept distinct.
